newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS assigns rating to Precision debt issue.
newsitem.headline: CBRS assigns rating to Precision debt issue.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Tuesday it assigned a B++ (high) rating to Precision Drilling Corp C$200 million debenture issue with a stable outlook.

The rating reflected Precision's leading position in Canada's oil service industry, strong operating fundamentals and an ability to maintain growth and profitability while keeping a conservative capital structure, CBRS said.
The rating is at the upper end of the medium quality scale and signifies established investment grade characteristics, CBRS said.
It said the rating incorporated the inherent volatility of the drilling industry, which can affect drilling and service revenues as well as credit ratios when energy prices drop.
But Precision's operating and financial risk profile was expected to withstand the industry pressures, it said.
Precision said it planned to issue a C$200 million, 10-year senior unsubordinated debenture, due June 2007, likely be the end of June. ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
